message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Seeking Efficient Ways to Export and Format OpenRouter Chat Logs as PDFs for Training","body":"I've been using OpenRouter extensively to test multiple AI models quickly and compare their responses in one interface, which has been great for development purposes (F1, F2). Some of these chat conversations, after editing out weaker responses and keeping the best ones, have proven valuable for training sessions I conduct (F3). Since my training materials are usually PDF-based (F4), I'm looking for an efficient way to export these OpenRouter chats into a reusable, well-formatted format like PDF without having to manually reformat everything. While I know OpenRouter offers JSON export options (F5), that format isn't ideal for direct use in training documents. Does anyone know of tools or workflows that can import OpenRouter chat data or integrate with multiple models to output nicely formatted chat logs directly? Ideally, something that can automate or simplify this process would be very helpful (F6). Thanks in advance for any pointers!","fact_refs":["F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","F6"]}]}
